title: Mikrokondo Output Schema
description: The Mikrokondo-specific schema used for validating IRIDA Next JSON output data

anyOf.description: All tool results for all samples in JSON format.
All tool results for all samples in TSV format.

checkm_value.description: The CheckM2-reported amount of contamination identified.

qc_status_read_depth_fixed.description: The QC status of the average read coverage depth.

qc_status_assembly_n50.description: The QC status of the assembly N50 value.

qc_status_read_qual.description: The QC status of the raw read average quality score.

raw_average_quality_value.description: The raw read average quality score.

qc_status_assembly_genome_size.description: The QC status of the assembly length.

qc_status_assembly_num_contigs.description: The QC status of the number of assembly contigs.

qc_status_wgmlst_loci.description: The QC status of the whole-genome MLST loci count.

qc_status_read_length.description: The QC status of the mean short-read length.

Downsampled.description: Whether or not the reads were downsampled.

locidex_db_name.description: The name of the Locidex database used.

locidex_db_date.description: The date of creation of the Locidex database used.

locidex_db_version.description: The version of the Locidex database used.

locidex_db_total_loci_count.description: The total number of loci in the Locidex database.

locidex_count_loci_found.description: The number of loci that Locidex found.

locidex_count_loci_missing.description: The number of loci that Locidex reported as missing.

locidex_loci_no_blast_hit.description: The number of loci for which Locidex found no BLAST hit.

locidex_loci_single_blast_hit.description: The number of loci for which Locidex found one BLAST hit.

locidex_loci_with_multiple_values.description: The number of loci for which Locidex found multple BLAST hits.

locidex_loci_no_nucleotide_hits.description: The number of loci for which Locidex found no nucleotide BLAST hits.

locidex_loci_no_protein_hits.description: The number of loci for which Locidex found no protein BLAST hits.

ECTyper Evidence.description: The evidence used by ECTyper for Escherichia coli serotyping.

ECTyper GeneCoverages (%).description: The percent gene coverages of the alleles used by ECTyper for Escherichia coli serotyping.

ECTyper GeneIdentities (%).description: The percent gene identities of the alleles used by ECTyper for Escherichia coli serotyping.

ECTyper GeneScores.description: The gene scores of the alleles used by ECTyper for Escherichia coli serotyping.

ECTyper H-Antigen.description: The H antigen reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper O-Antigen.description: The O antigen reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper QCFlag.description: The quality control flag reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Serotype.description: The Escherichia coli serotype reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Subtyping.description: Species identification information reported by ECTyper in case of inadvertent sample contamination or mislabelling events.

ECTyper Pathotype.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Counts.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype gene counts reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Genes.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype genes reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Gene Names.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype gene names reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Accessions.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype accessions reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Allele IDs.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype allele IDs reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Identities (%).description: The Escherichia coli pathotype percent identities reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Coverages (%).description: The Escherichia coli pathotype percent coverages reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Gene Length Ratios.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype gene length ratios reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Rule IDs.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype rule IDs reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Pathotype Gene Counts.description: The Escherichia coli pathotype gene counts reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper PathoDBVer.description: The pathotype database version used by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Subtypes.description: The Shiga toxin subtypes reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Accessions.description: The Shiga toxin accessions reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Allele IDs.description: The Shiga toxin allele IDs reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Allele Names.description: The Shiga toxin allele names reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Identities (%).description: The Shiga toxin percent identities reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Coverages (%).description: The Shiga toxin percent coverages reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Lengths.description: The Shiga toxin lengths reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Contig Names.description: The Shiga toxin contig names reported by ECTyper.

ECTyper Stx Coordinates.description: The Shiga toxin coordinates reported by ECTyper.

LISSERO Serotype.description: The Listeria monocytogenes serotype predicted by LisSero.

Mean Sequence Length Forward.description: The mean sequence length of forward reads.

Mean Sequence Length Reverse.description: The mean sequence length of reverse reads.

SISTR cgMLST ST.description: SISTR-reported core genome MLST Salmonella serotype.

SISTR cgMLST Found Loci.description: The number of cgMLST loci found by SISTR.

SISTR cgMLST Genome Match.description: The genome match reported by SISTR.

SISTR cgMLST Matching Alleles.description: The number of matching alleles found by SISTR.

SISTR cgMLST Subspecies.description: The cgMLST subspecies reported by SISTR.

SISTR H1.description: The H1 antigen reported by SISTR.

SISTR H2.description: The H2 antigen reported by SISTR.

SISTR Antigen.description: The O antigen reported by SISTR.

SISTR QC Message.description: The quality control message reported by SISTR.

SISTR QC Status.description: The quality control status reported by SISTR.

SISTR Serogroup.description: The Salmonella serogroup reported by SISTR.

SISTR Serovar.description: The Salmonella serovar reported by SISTR.

SISTR Serovar Antigen.description: The Salmonella serovar antigen reported by SISTR.

SISTR Serovar cgMLST.description: The serovar cgMLST reported by SISTR.

7 Gene ST.description: The seven gene MLST sequence type reported by MLST (the software).

7 Gene Scheme.description: The seven gene MLST scheme reported by MLST (the software).

StarAMR Predicted Phenotype.description: The antimicrobial resistance phenotype reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR CGE Predicted Phenotype.description: The CGE-predicted antimicrobial resistance phenotype reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR Plasmid.description: Antimicrobial resistance plasmid information reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR Sequence Type.description: The sequence type reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR Genome Length.description: The genome length reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR N50 Value.description: The assembly N50 value reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR Number of Contigs Greater Than O.description: The number of contigs greater than or equal to 300 base pairs as reported by StarAMR.

StarAMR Quality Module Feedback.description: Quality module feedback as reported by StarAMR.

predicted_identification_name.description: The species name predicted by Mikrokondo.

predicted_identification_method.description: The method used by Mikrokondo to predict the species.

total_sequenced_bases.description: The total number of sequenced bases.

total_sequenced_reads.description: The total number of sequenced reads.

predicted_primary_type_name.description: The predicted primary type as determined by Mikrokondo. This can vary according to the species (ex: serovar, serotype, etc.).

predicted_primary_type_method.description: The method used to predict the primary type. This can vary according to the species.

predicted_secondary_type_name.description: The predicted secondary type as determined by Mikrokondo. This can vary according to the species (ex: serovar, serotype, etc.). This uses an alternative method from the primary method to determine the type.

predicted_secondary_type_method.description: The method used to predict the secondary type. This can vary according to the species.

QUAST_Average_Coverage_Depth.description: The average coverage depth as reported by QUAST.

SeqtkBaseCount.description: The base count as reported by Seqtk.

IdentificationMethod.description: The method used to identify the species.
